hero.body: We connect students with tutors from their own institution. Book sessions, pay securely and improve your academic results.

steps.title: How it works
steps.subtitle: Three simple steps and you can have your first tutoring session.

one.title: Find your tutor
one.body: Search tutors at your institution by subject, rating and availability.

two.title: Book a session
two.body: Pick the time that suits you and pay securely with PayPal.

three.title: Learn in real time
three.body: Join the video call, learn, and confirm the session when you are done.

institutions.title: Reduce student drop-out with real data
institutions.body: Macaw gives your institution real-time academic analytics, subsidy tools for students at risk, and verified tutors from its own community.
institutions.point1: Dashboard with analytics per academic unit
institutions.point2: Subsidies straight to students at risk
institutions.point3: Verified tutors from your own institution
